evidence: The Vietnam Women's Museum is located at 36 Ly Thai To Street, Hang Bai Ward, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi, near Hoan Kiem Lake and the Old Quarter. Established in 1987 under the Vietnam Women's Union, the museum opened to the public in 1995 and has since served hundreds of thousands of domestic and international visitors annually.
